text: Sorry, I didn't want to interrupt. I can come back later if you're busy.
No, not at all, have a seat. I was hoping someone would join me.
Thanks, that's kind. I'm still finding my way around here, to be honest.
Then let me show you around after lunch. I know everyone on this floor.
That would be great, I'd really appreciate it.
Sure. The coffee machine on the left is the one that works.
Good to know. I'll bring us both a cup on the way back, then.
